text: {"lessons":["Ten periods of uneven results are too little evidence to judge a strategy; I should avoid reacting to monthly gains and losses without a sound long-term plan.","Repeatedly selling after losses and then buying back can turn indecision into poor timing; I should decide in advance what would justify changing a holding.","Because I invest toward an apartment within ten years, I should balance growth with diversification and keep enough cash for future contributions and needs."]}
